# C152 振幅学習 / 2026-11-12 — 診断③を目標。旧セルは実行しない。
from google.colab import files
uploaded_magnitude = files.upload()
# 入力照合と環境準備
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, io, json, subprocess, sys, zipfile
blob=uploaded_magnitude['irodori-mf07-magnitude-input-20261112-v1.zip']
assert hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest() == '1bfd8884da4eb3bd2a05dc2a04c7239bd168f482636e046ebb595f0bdec9f906'
mag_root=Path('/content/sumi_mf07_magnitude_20261112')
mag_root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
mag_input=mag_root/'input'; mag_input.mkdir()
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(blob)) as archive:
    assert all((mag_input/n).resolve().is_relative_to(mag_input.resolve()) for n in archive.namelist())
    archive.extractall(mag_input)
checks=json.loads((mag_input/'SHA256.json').read_text())
for name,expected in checks.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((mag_input/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,name
print('MAGNITUDE_INPUT_VERIFIED',len(checks),len(blob))
mag_setup_log=mag_root/'setup.log'
with mag_setup_log.open('x') as stream:
    mag_setup=subprocess.Popen(['timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=10s','600s',sys.executable,'-m','pip','install','torch==2.10.0','numpy==2.2.6','scipy==1.15.3'],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('SETUP_STARTED',mag_setup.pid)
# 準備の状態
print('SETUP_RETURN_CODE',mag_setup.poll())
print(mag_setup_log.read_text()[-1800:])
# 位相固定・振幅のみ3000更新、学習ループ上限240秒
assert mag_setup.poll()==0
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','discover','-s',str(mag_input),'-p','test_magnitude.py','-v'],check=True,timeout=60)
subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=name,memory.total','--format=csv,noheader'],check=True)
mag_output=mag_root/'output'
mag_log=mag_root/'training.log'
with mag_log.open('x') as stream:
    mag_process=subprocess.Popen(['timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=10s','300s',sys.executable,'-u',str(mag_input/'train_magnitude.py'),'--data',str(mag_input/'data'),'--base',str(mag_input/'base.pt'),'--output',str(mag_output),'--device','cuda','--steps','3000','--max-seconds','240'],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('MAGNITUDE_TRAINING_STARTED',mag_process.pid)
# 学習状態
print('TRAINING_RETURN_CODE',mag_process.poll())
print(mag_log.read_text()[-2200:])
if (mag_output/'completed.json').exists(): print((mag_output/'completed.json').read_text())
# 結果の退避。Macへ保存・照合してからランタイムを停止する。
assert mag_process.poll() is not None
mag_zip=Path('/content/sumi_mf07_magnitude_results_20261112.zip')
with zipfile.ZipFile(mag_zip,'x',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
    for item in sorted(mag_root.rglob('*')):
        if item.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in item.parts:
            archive.write(item,str(item.relative_to(mag_root)))
print('RESULT_ZIP',mag_zip.stat().st_size,hashlib.sha256(mag_zip.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
files.download(str(mag_zip))
